title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 7-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$7$$ parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the remaining $$6$$ parts are used for training.

title: Calculating Model Fits
text: For each combination of hyperparameters, a model is trained using $$6$$ parts of the data and validated on the 7th part. This process is repeated for each fold.

title: Total Combinations
text: Milena tests $$2$$ values of lambda and $$5$$ values of rho, resulting in $$2\times5=10$$ combinations of hyperparameters.

title: Calculating Total Model Fits
text: Each data point is used in the training set $$6$$ times for each fold. With $$10$$ combinations of hyperparameters, how many times is each data point used to fit a model?
